SLAYTHEREQUIEM-EBB_STONES_EVENT.title: Six Stones by the Water
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-EBB_STONES_EVENT.pages.IN: Six stones lie in the shallows, humming with the ebb. Three of them are within reach. A shard taken now will last until the end of the act.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-EBB_STONES_EVENT.pages.TA: The stone is warm in your hand. The tide will take it back when the act ends.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-EBB_STONES_EVENT.pages.LE: You walk away. The stones keep humming.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHRINE_EVENT.title: Shrine
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHRINE_EVENT.pages.INITIA: A quiet shrine of one of the Celestials. A priest tends the candles and sells relics of the god's set: an Amulet for 120 gold and a Robe for 150.
You already carry this god's blessing.
The Celestials do not answer the Apostate.
Donate [gold]{Cost}[/gold] gold: righteousness +1 step (once per act).
Requires [gold]{Cost}[/gold] gold; once per act; impossible for the Outcast's chosen.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHRINE_EVENT.pages.BLESSE: Warmth spreads through you. Anything else?
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHRINE_EVENT.pages.REDEEM: The priest nods. A weight lifts from your soul.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHRINE_EVENT.pages.BOUGHT: The priest wraps the relic in clean linen.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHRINE_EVENT.pages.ROBBED: You run, the offering bowl clinking. Somewhere a candle goes out.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DARK_SHRINE_EVENT.title: Dark Shrine
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DARK_SHRINE_EVENT.pages.I: An altar of black stone. Two Princes of the Abyss offer their gifts — each with a Price. A pact makes you Apostate.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DARK_SHRINE_EVENT.pages.A: The pact is sealed. The Prince is watching.
